crawlNote: Fetched cancellation policy and privacy/grievance pages. support.nykaa.com was not fully extracted. Nykaa Fashion and Nykaa Man policies were read as sister properties, not scored as the same site.
summary: Nykaa documents refunds, returns, chat hours, and a named grievance officer. The public pages still disagree with themselves on the two things a stuck customer needs first: the return clock, and the phone number.

dimensions.label: Internal consistency
dimensions.note: Same brand property uses 15 days and 15 business days. Two different toll-free numbers on two official pages.

dimensions.label: Help vs marketing
dimensions.note: Policy leads with an “Easy return policy” then lists hygiene, custom, and campaign exceptions. Sister sites quote 7-day and 5-day windows.

dimensions.label: High-intent coverage
dimensions.note: Cancel, return, refund timing, exclusions, data-delete path, grievance officer.

dimensions.label: Path to a human
dimensions.note: Email, chat hours, named officer. Phone number is not stable across pages.

dimensions.label: Bot / chat honesty
dimensions.note: Chat is listed as customer service on app and desktop, 8 AM–10 PM. No public statement of whether that chat is a bot.

findings.title: Return window is 15 days and 15 business days on the same policy
findings.whyItHurts: A customer on day 16 calendar / day 12 business cannot tell if they still have a right. That is when tickets explode.
findings.fix: Pick one clock. Use it in every sentence. Put it in the first 80 words of the policy.

evidence.quote: you can raise a return/exchange request of a product within 15 days of its delivery
If request is initiated after 15 business days of order delivery

findings.title: Two official toll-free numbers
findings.whyItHurts: The first thing a failed chat user does is call. Two numbers is a support-ops leak, not a copy typo.
findings.fix: One number everywhere. Redirect the retired number. Update cancellation-policy and the grievance block together.

evidence.quote: Or call us on 1800-267-4444 (Monday To Sunday, 8AM to 10PM).
Phone: 1800-267-88888 (Mon to Sun, 8 AM to 10 PM)

findings.title: “Easy return policy” sits above a long ineligible list
findings.whyItHurts: Customers hear the slogan, buy a mascara or appliance, then hit hygiene and custom-product exclusions.
findings.fix: Lead with “returns in 15 days, except these categories” and name the exceptions in the same paragraph.

evidence.quote: Nykaa offers its customers an ’Easy return policy’
Personal care appliances cannot be returned due to hygiene issues

findings.title: Wallet refunds are refused on cancellation
findings.whyItHurts: A customer who paid with wallet expects wallet back. The refusal is legal if stated. It is easy to miss.
findings.fix: Put payment-method refund rules in a table at the top of the cancel section.

evidence.quote: We do not offer wallet refunds for cancellations

widgets.evidence: Privacy policy: Chat with our Customer Service Team on Nykaa App and Desktop (Mon to Sun, 8 AM to 10 PM)
